lines.2: 「Hey, when are you finally getting rid of this dial-up connection? It's so slow I can't stand it.」
lines.3: 「You could stop surfing the web at my house.」
lines.4: 「Time to check your history! Let's see if you've visited anywhere dirty. If I find any abusive childhood-friend stuff, I'm never speaking to you again.」
lines.6: 「So, what did the head of the disciplinary committee want to talk about today?」
